description: This file implements traversal logic for an intermediate representation tree in a shader compiler, including node visiting, traversal control, and tree modification functions.

classes.name: TIntermNode
classes.description: Base class for all nodes in the intermediate representation tree.

classes.name: TIntermSymbol
classes.description: Represents a symbol node in the IR tree.

classes.name: TIntermAggregate
classes.description: Represents an aggregate node (function call or constructor).

classes.name: TIntermBranch
classes.description: Represents a branch statement (break, continue, return).

classes.name: TIntermCase
classes.description: Represents a case within a switch statement.

classes.name: TIntermTraverser
classes.description: Class responsible for traversing and modifying the IR tree.

classes.name: TLValueTrackingTraverser
classes.description: Specialized traverser that tracks l-value requirements during traversal.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Generic method to traverse a node and its children.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Method called when visiting a node, can be overridden for custom behavior.

methods.name: traverseBinary
methods.description: Traverse a binary node, handling specific logic for binary operations.

methods.name: traverseFunctionDefinition
methods.description: Traverse a function definition node, managing scope.

methods.name: traverseBlock
methods.description: Traverse a block node, managing statement sequence.

methods.name: updateTree
methods.description: Apply queued modifications to the AST, such as insertions and replacements.

methods.name: setInFunctionCallOutParameter
methods.description: Set whether the current node is an out parameter in a function call.

methods.name: isInFunctionCallOutParameter
methods.description: Check if currently in a function call out parameter context.
